subject.statement: Elizabeth Holmes was convicted of defrauding both investors and patients.

summary: Elizabeth Holmes was convicted in 2022 on multiple counts of wire fraud and conspiracy related to defrauding investors, but she was acquitted (or the charges were dropped) on all counts pertaining to defrauding patients. Thus she was not convicted of defrauding both investors and patients.
